attempted_axis: WebFrank closure of the parked emission-order/colouring coupling: screen it hard against the sysResetService rejection shape, then separate the coupling into a permutation stage legal in OUR colouring plus a recolor stage

attributes.harness: build/scratch/wfharness.py, self-validated against the shipped ExpToLevel rule before use.
attributes.law_screen: claim.law.webfrank-permutation-is-audited-in-our-colouring.20260831.v1 APPLIED as the DECISIVE screen and its warning discharged. The queue flagged this candidate as likely to repeat the REJECTED sysResetService shape (permutation legal only under the target's colouring). It does not: the four moved atoms are LITERALLY IDENTICAL words that only change position, so the permuted-but-not-yet-recolored intermediate image is genuine correct code and check_permutation_dependences passes reading our own register names. That law's rule (2) also decided the region SIZE - the masked byte scan flags an adjacent-looking pair, but the true region is FIVE atoms because an independent lfs sits between the two lis atoms; the scan was treated as a lower bound and the region widened, exactly as the law prescribes. Its enabling mechanic (a) was used: permutation and recolor share ONE patch entry because the permutation is legal in our colouring. claim.law.webfrank-pinned-function-source-freeze.20260831.v1 and claim.law.webfrank-pin-freezes-its-inlined-helpers-too.20260831.v1 APPLIED as a consequence: tower.c had NO prior pin and now has one, so SumnerDoSpeech and every static helper inlined into it are source-frozen - relevant because tower.c also DEFINES playerGiveGargItem, screened in this same lane. claim.law.webfrank-hash-pinned-site.20260830.v1 APPLIED (same consequence). claim.law.gcb-sflags-relocation-alias.20260830.v1 SCREENED and material: it is why no memory disambiguation was attempted; none was needed, as the region contains no store. NO src/*.c edit was made.
attributes.residual: NONE. fndiff --clean reports EXACT, 0 real diff lines. The coupling the park could not separate comes apart cleanly into two stages in one patch entry. (1) Emission order: the two @ha/@lo address materializations at +0x1f0 are built in opposite order - ours gPlayers before lbl_80124D84, retail the reverse - and because the lfs f31 SDA load at +0x1f4 sits between the two lis atoms the region is five atoms with order [2, 1, 0, 4, 3]. All four ADDR16_HA/ADDR16_LO relocations ride their own atoms with payloads preserved; the intervening lfs touches none of r3/r4/r29/r30, so every def-use chain and final write survives. (2) The remainder is a single r26 -> r24 recolor of the speech-record web (+0x144 mr., +0x150 addi, +0x190 lha). LESSON: an 'order + colour' coupling is NOT automatically the sysResetService rejection class. The discriminating question is narrow - are the moved atoms legal where they land under OUR register names? When the moved atoms are identical words, the answer is always yes and the coupling separates.
